verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a payments platform with developer APIs, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an Adyen command-line tool. The nearby items (the MCP server, OpenAPI definitions, Postman import, the Management API, and llms.txt/markdown docs) are adjacent developer resources, not an official CLI, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
